anya: FYI I hit a nasty oscillation during burst testing where fallback -> preempt -> fallback repeated and tripped tenant throttles.
anya: repro: run TestShardFallbackPreempt in the orchestrator sim. snippet from logs:
2026-03-01T11:12:01Z INFO admission: admit shard=shard-11 tenant=tn-42 tokens=512
2026-03-01T11:12:01Z WARN preempt: evict shard=shard-11 reason=preemptible-credit-exhausted
2026-03-01T11:12:01Z INFO fallback: reroute req=xyz -> shard-3
2026-03-01T11:12:01Z WARN preempt: evict shard=shard-3 reason=hotspot
2026-03-01T11:12:02Z ERROR admission: throttle spike tenant=tn-42 rate=500/s
anya: config used: headroom=3, burst_credits=120, preemptible=true, eviction_priority:{burst:5,preemptible:10}.
julia: sounds like fallback ignores recent preempt history and picks shards that are still unstable. leads to repeated reassigns.
mike: options: per-shard cooldown after eviction, bias fallback to shards flagged stable, or add small randomized retry delay. cooldown seems simplest.
sam: agree but cooldown reduces available fallbacks. need a detector to avoid punishing healthy churn.
julia: propose a flapping detector: preempt_count_1m and reassigns_30s; mark shard flapping when both exceed thresholds and treat as last-resort.
mike: also differentiate eviction types: preemptible -> short cooldown (5-15s), hotspot/oom -> longer (30-120s).
anya: should allocator notify autoscaler? many fallbacks could indicate capacity shortage.
sam: emit fallback_amplification metric and let scaler create a low-confidence scale intent if it crosses threshold. ops can review spikes.
julia: also expose request hint prefer_stable_shard in SDK to let callers opt-in.
mike: rollout: implement flapping detector + per-shard cooldown behind feature flag, emit metric, add SDK hint, canary for 48h.
anya: I'll draft a short RFC with thresholds and sim results and open a PR. ping @orch-bot when PR is up so CI runs the sim.
orch-bot: CI queued: orch-integration/sim-fallback 1728888801 -> status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anya: thanks — will post link here when ready. :thumbsup:)
